name: Akagi Yuka
source:
She feels anxious whether an accident or incident will occur on the aircraft whenever she boards.

Rude people among the passengers, are a constant source of trouble for her.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=707787&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
